snapshot.title: Chlorine Residual Alarm — Clearwell 2

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

transcript.speaker: Distribution On-Call
transcript.text: Control, this is Distribution On-Call. I’ve just arrived at Millbrook General Hospital. The pressure gauge PIT-600 shows 18 psi — it was 24 psi at 05:00. The facility’s water safety officer says they’ve had no water for 15 minutes. I’ve confirmed the main break is not visible on the street, but the pressure has dropped sharply.

transcript.speaker: IC
transcript.text: Understood. Confirm the break location with the field team. Begin manual isolation of the Hilltop Transmission Main. Initiate Zone 2 pressure alert per Section 9.2. Notify the PIO and WQ.

snapshot.instructorNote: This call triggers the public advisory decision process. Watch for the team to validate the pressure drop and initiate the Boil Water Advisory protocol.
